games.title: The Last Lantern
games.blurb: Oil runs low in the catacombs. The watchers wait past the edge of the light.
games.description: A mobile-first atmospheric exploration game. Descend three procedurally generated depths with a lantern that keeps burning low. Collect lore, solve light puzzles, and keep the flame from going out — because when it dies, the watchers close in.
games.how: Walk with a floating stick (lower half of the screen). Aim your gaze with a drag in the upper half. Hold Raise to widen the light (burns oil faster) or Lower to shrink it to an ember. Use interacts with braziers, mirrors, and seals. Find the stair at each depth after solving its light puzzle.

games.title: Bayshift
games.blurb: Drag chunky freight crates out through bay doors of their color, before the ferry whistle blows.
games.description: A mobile-first, timed block-escape puzzle on a midnight dock. Crates come in multi-cell shapes and move freely under your finger. Each one ships only through a bay door of its own color, and only if it fits through the door. Plan a route through a packed deck, park crates out of the way, and beat the clock. Eighteen handcrafted bays ramp from a single straight shot to full night-rush jams with frosted crates, rail-locked crates, shrink-wrapped crates that need two doors, and roller shutters that open only after enough loads of their color have shipped.
games.how: Drag a crate with your finger. It rides the grid on magnetic rails, following your finger along a row or column and turning a corner when you clearly move sideways. Flick it to send it gliding until it hits something, or straight out through a matching door. Push a crate into a bay door of the same color to ship it, but every row or column it covers has to fit inside the door. The clock starts on your first drag, and shipping everything with time to spare earns 3 stars. Frosted crates thaw after the number of loads shown. Railed crates only move along their track. Wrapped crates peel off one layer per door and show the color underneath. A shuttered door opens after its counter of matching loads is met. Undo is unlimited and steps back one drag or flick at a time. Break freezes the clock for 10 seconds and Lift removes one crate; each can be used once per bay. If time runs out, you can take one 30-second overtime.

games.title: Moonroost
games.blurb: One owl to every moonlit grove. They won't share a row or a column, and they won't touch, not even at a corner.
games.description: A mobile-first logic puzzle set in a hushed night wood. Each board is split into colored groves, and every grove needs exactly one owl. No two owls may share a row or a column, and none may perch beside another, even diagonally. Every board has a single solution you can reach by pure deduction, so cross out the branches that can't hold an owl, squeeze the wood down, and land each owl only where it must go. There are 36 handcrafted campaign groves that ramp from 5×5 warm-ups to 10×10 knots, plus an endless Deep wood and a fresh roost every night with a streak.
games.how: Tap a cell to cross it out, and tap again to clear it. Drag across cells to cross out a whole run; the stroke snaps to its row or column. Double-tap to land an owl. Correct owls lock in, but a wrong perch costs one of your three moons. Placed owls automatically dim every cell they rule out (you can turn this off in pause). Listen explains the next logical step when you're stuck, spending one song: you start with 3 and earn another each time you settle a new grove flawlessly. Undo steps back your crosses, and Clear wipes them. Finish with every moon and no hints for a flawless Silent wings mark.
